name: LunaTV
description: 本项目采用 CC BY-NC-SA 协议，禁止任何商业化行为，任何衍生项目必须保留本项目地址并以相同协议开源
one_liner: A self-hosted app that lets you search and stream movies and TV shows from multiple free sources in one place, like building your own private streaming service.
buyer: This one is a legal dead end for most buyers: its license explicitly bans any commercial use, and the app itself ships empty of content, relying on whatever streaming sources a user plugs in.
business_use_cases: None that hold up commercially — the project's own license (CC BY-NC-SA) forbids commercialization, and it depends on the user supplying their own content sources of unknown legality.
A hobbyist could self-host it for personal use, but that isn't a business.
Not viable as a foundation to build a business on.

money_ideas.idea: None recommended — the non-commercial license and reliance on user-supplied, unverified streaming sources rule out legitimate monetization.

steal_this: Skip this one. If you want a legitimate weekend project in this space, build a personal watchlist and tracker app that links out to services you actually hold a license to use.
